mapper.sql: t.id task_id,t.instance_id,i.document_id,i.version_id,d.type document_type,d.number document_number,d.revision document_revision,t.node,t.assignee_id, u.user_name submitter_name,v.submitted_by submitter_id,v.version_no,t.status task_status,t.revision task_revision,v.submitted_at,t.comment
mapper.select: select from workflow_tasks t join workflow_instances i on i.id=t.instance_id join documents d on d.id=i.document_id join document_versions v on v.id=i.version_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=v.submitted_by where t.assignee_id=#{assigneeId} and t.status='PENDING' and i.status='RUNNING' and d.approval_status='IN_REVIEW' and d.current_node=t.node and d.deleted='0' order by v.submitted_at desc

select from workflow_tasks t join workflow_instances i on i.id=t.instance_id join documents d on d.id=i.document_id join document_versions v on v.id=i.version_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=v.submitted_by where t.id=#{taskId} and i.status='RUNNING' and d.approval_status='IN_REVIEW' and d.current_node=t.node and d.deleted='0'
mapper.update: update workflow_tasks set status='COMPLETED',decision=#{decision},comment=#{comment},acted_by=#{actorId},acted_at=#{actedAt},revision=revision+1 where id=#{taskId} and revision=#{revision} and assignee_id=#{actorId} and status='PENDING'

update documents set approval_status=#{status},current_node=#{currentNode},revision=revision+1,update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{documentId} and revision=#{revision} and approval_status='IN_REVIEW' and current_node=#{expectedNode} and deleted='0'
update workflow_tasks set status='CANCELLED',revision=revision+1 where instance_id=#{instanceId} and status='PENDING'
update workflow_instances set status=#{status},finished_at=#{finishedAt} where id=#{instanceId} and status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: select c.finance_candidates from workflow_instances i join workflow_configs c on c.version=i.config_version where i.id=#{instanceId} and c.flow_type='INVOICE_APPROVAL'

select count(1) from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.user_id<>#{submitterId} and u.user_id<>#{purchaseId} and u.status='0' and r.status='0' and r.role_key='finance'
mapper.update: update invoice_allocations set state='CONFIRMED' where invoice_id=#{documentId} and state='RESERVED'
update invoice_allocations set state='RELEASED' where invoice_id=#{documentId} and state='RESERVED'
